visualizationDefinition: Displays a weighted undirected graph and highlights the edges belonging to the minimum cut.

solver.solverDefinition: Finds the global minimum cut of a weighted undirected graph using the Stoer-Wagner algorithm in O(V³) time.
solver.source: Stoer, Mechthild, and Frank Wagner. "A simple min-cut algorithm." Journal of the ACM 44, no. 4 (1997): 585-591.
